notes: Boot harl_a13 with four balls on trough switches 11-14, the stacking opto 15 at 0 and the motorcycle down on 36, with PinMAME's built-in motorcycle mechanism off. Walk the Portals service menu with the Black ENTER (public 0) and Green RIGHT (public -1) service buttons: Portals, MAIN MENU (DIAG), DIAGNOSTICS MENU, two steps right to LAMP, LAMP MENU (ONE), and enter the Single Lamp Test, whose cursor starts on the + icon. Press Black 82 times: each press steps to the next lamp, flashes it and prints the name, the drive and return wire colours and the number the ROM holds for it, so the run covers lamps 1-80 and shows what follows the last one.
